pages.title: Hotpot Loop Sort
pages.creator: lilina
pages.description: Hotpot Loop Sort puts you in charge of ingredients traveling around a conveyor. Tap and flip the food, then place it on the belt to match the hotpot's ingredient hints. Time each drop while keeping enough space for incoming dishes. Wrong ingredients and an overloaded conveyor cause problems, and later levels bring more food and faster loops to manage.

pages.title: Card Clash : Battle Arena
pages.creator: s1interactivestudio
pages.description: In Card Clash : Battle Arena, merging cards supplies the fighters for an advancing army. Combine five matching cards of one color to summon a hero, then let that character fight automatically. Your troops must eliminate the enemies in their path before moving farther into the battlefield. Keep creating heroes to support the attack and destroy the opposing base to complete the level.

pages.title: Hawaii Match 6
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Hawaii Match 6 is a tropical matching puzzle with fruit, flowers, and other island symbols. Combine pieces to meet each board's goals before using up the available moves. Matches can produce bonuses, and unlockable boosters help with the puzzles as you travel through the game's island landscapes.

pages.title: WordMix
pages.creator: Wit Games
pages.description: WordMix asks you to discover connections between word cards and organize them into rows. Look for words related by a shared theme, meaning, or association, then move them into one group. A correctly completed row locks into place. Solve every group to finish the level, working within a limited number of moves and using a hint when a connection is difficult to spot. An endless mode offers another way to play.

pages.title: Wool Sorting
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Wool Sorting is a puzzle about joining colored yarn pieces into complete threads. Select wool segments, then drag them into position to bring matching colors together. Arrange the pieces in the right sequence as you work through the levels. Rotation and an undo action give you ways to adjust a placement.

pages.title: Fruit Merge Arena
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fruit Merge Arena has you drop fruit into a limited playing area and combine identical pieces into larger varieties. Aim each drop with the mouse, then click or tap to release it. Work through the fruit combinations toward a watermelon while keeping the board from filling. A rewarded-ad option removes every instance of a chosen fruit when you need extra room.

pages.title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo puts you in the role of a tattoo artist serving customers with individual design requests. Create their requested tattoos, making careful work of each session as you bring their ideas onto the skin.

pages.title: Bunny Blox
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Bunny Blox combines movable, rotating pieces with matching groups of at least three. Help the bunny collect blox by positioning each item before dropping it. Swipe sideways to move, upward to rotate, and downward to drop. Special rewards appear during play and can clear areas of the board.

pages.title: Cunning Ginger
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a traveling red cat toward falling treats in Cunning Ginger while keeping him away from harmful objects. Collect foods such as fish, chicken, cheese, and hamburgers, and look out for bonus items including magnets and helmets. Cacti, irons, coconuts, and boots cost a life, while other objects complicate the journey. Move the cat with the mouse or a finger, or steer left and right using the arrow keys or A and D.

pages.title: Xeno Defense Protocol
pages.creator: FialaGames
pages.description: Xeno Defense Protocol combines overhead shooting, base defense, and role-playing progression. Establish a base and protect it from repeated waves of insect-like enemies while fighting to survive. The mission also calls for a successful extraction, giving you another objective beyond holding off the attacks.

pages.title: VegaMix Da Vinci Puzzles
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description:
VegaMix Da Vinci Puzzles sends Alice, Vika, and Lesha to Renaissance Italy after their time machine malfunctions. Complete match-3 puzzles and story quests to help Leonardo da Vinci finish inventions and recover missing blueprints so the travelers can return home.

Line up three matching tiles to remove them, or build special shapes for stronger effects. Four in a line creates a rocket that clears a line, while a four-tile square makes a target-seeking spinner. Five tiles in a T produce an area-clearing bomb; five in a line create a piece that removes one color.

pages.title: My Arcade Center
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description: Build an arcade business in My Arcade Center, collecting tokens during the day and improving machines at night. Expand the selection of games, arrange the floor, and hire staff to help run the venue. Coin bots also assist with operations. Customer management includes dealing with freeloaders and vandals as the business grows across nine maps. Move around the arcade with WASD, the arrow keys, or a mouse drag; touch controls use a held tap and drag.

pages.title: Capybara Xmas Merge
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Capybara Xmas Merge fills a container with Christmas-themed capybaras that roll and collide after you drop them. Tap to release a character and bring two identical ones together to produce a larger capybara. Keep combining them to increase your score and build the biggest character you can before the container runs out of room.

pages.title: Color Block Sort
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Color Block Sort asks you to organize scattered blocks by color. Tap to move pieces, stacking them only with blocks of the same color. Your goal is to gather every block of a particular color into one space and finish sorting the board.

pages.title: Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure is a platform game about guiding an orange ball past hostile stones. Move and jump through different biomes, find the key, and use it to open the door to the level's finish. The ball has three hearts, and some stages hide secrets. Use the arrow keys or WASD to control the ball, or press the on-screen movement and jump buttons. Colorful ball skins provide additional looks.

pages.title: Dino Slide
pages.creator: Wolele
pages.description: Slide the dinosaur toward its food in Dino Slide. Each level sets an eating goal involving fruits and vegetables, and you must move Dino around the puzzle to collect what is needed. Use the arrow keys or swipe to choose a direction.

pages.title: Brainrot Evolution Game
pages.creator: FunFox Games
pages.description: Guide a growing group of creatures across the field in Brainrot Evolution Game. Drag to steer toward creatures of the same rank or lower and absorb them into your group. Three matching members combine into a stronger form, letting you pursue higher-ranked targets. Avoid larger creatures that can eat your followers; losing the whole group ends the run. Keep merging until you reach the final evolution.

pages.title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Cool Girl Aesthetics lets you create Mia’s style across several makeover activities. Customize her Stanley cup with colors, prints, and accessories, then decorate her headphones. Design a manicure with nail colors, rings, and temporary tattoos before choosing makeup details such as face stickers and colorful braces.

pages.title: Survival Racing: Extreme Road
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Survival Racing: Extreme Road sends you into races where reaching the finish also means surviving the course. Drive past obstacles, avoid traps, and contend with rival racers as you try to take first place. Steer with WASD and use the space bar for the handbrake; C changes the camera view.

pages.title: The Counterfeit Bank
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: The Counterfeit Bank puts you in charge of a fictional fake-money operation. Print counterfeit notes and spread them through the economy while concealing your activities behind front companies. Choose between businesses with different profits and risks of detection, and expand into districts where stronger enforcement can accompany larger rewards. Your aim is to undermine the economy without being stopped by the authorities.

pages.title: Youtuber Mcraft 2Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Youtuber Mcraft 2Player follows a YouTuber and her boyfriend as they try to escape prison together. Collect the YouTube plaques while keeping the pair close to each other. Find the key and golden plaque, reach and open the chest, then make your way to the exit door. Use WASD and the arrow keys to move the characters, with double jumps available.

pages.title: Funny Balls 2048
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Funny Balls 2048 turns number merging into a physics puzzle. Drop numbered balls into the play area and bring two matching values together to create a ball worth twice as much. The balls bounce as they land, so their movement affects where the next merge can happen. Boosters and alternative ball skins are also available.

pages.title: Battleship
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Place your fleet on a concealed grid in Battleship, then take turns firing at positions on your opponent’s board. You must work out where the enemy ships are while protecting the locations of your own. Victory goes to the first side that sinks the entire opposing fleet.

pages.title: Devs Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build an IT company in Devs Simulator by recruiting programmers and managing the resources behind the business. Improve equipment and software, attract customers, and turn their work into profit. As director, you must develop the team and expand the company, balancing staffing with the tools needed to support its growth.

pages.title: Phrasle Master
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Phrasle Master asks you to reconstruct sayings, proverbs, and quotes by selecting words. You have five attempts per puzzle. Green marks a word in the correct position, yellow indicates it belongs elsewhere, and gray means it is absent from the phrase. A word can appear more than once, and the hidden phrases grow longer as you advance.

pages.title: Impossible Parkour
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Impossible Parkour presents a series of movement challenges across 25 levels. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and click to jump as you work through each course. Different stages introduce new challenges, with an in-game tutorial available to explain the controls.

pages.title: 2020! Jelly Time
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fit jelly-shaped pieces onto the board in 2020! Jelly Time. Drag blocks into open spaces and complete horizontal or vertical lines to remove them and earn points. Clearing several lines together raises your score, while charging the booster gauge lets you rotate pieces. Keep room for new shapes: the game ends when you can no longer fit them onto the grid.

pages.title: Movie Star Daily Routine
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Movie Star Daily Routine takes you through an actress’s day, from morning preparations to a red-carpet appearance. Begin with skincare, then move on to exercise and makeup for a screen test. Later, gather the items for her clutch and choose an outfit for her arrival on the red carpet. You can save the resulting look as a PNG image.

pages.title: Modern Air Warplane WW2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Modern Air Warplane WW2 is a 3D aerial combat game featuring modern fighter aircraft. Take a warplane into the skies and use its weapons against hostile jets in dogfights. A selection of aircraft provides different planes to take into these air battles.

pages.title: Draw and Save The Car
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Draw and Save The Car challenges you to sketch bridges that help a vehicle reach its destination. Shape each crossing around the obstacles and dangers on the route, adapting your drawing as the stages become more complicated. Complete missions to earn coins, then use them to unlock more powerful cars.

pages.title: Money Rush 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Money Rush 3D is an arcade collecting game in which you gather cash and shoot at clothes along the route. Shooting the clothing gives you more money to collect as you progress. Slide to steer as you gather money along the route.

pages.title: ArmedForces.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: ArmedForces.io puts you in a soldier’s role across a selection of combat maps and game modes. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the right mouse button and fire with the left. You can switch weapons, pick up equipment and use available dynamite or medkits. Running, sliding and crouching give you additional ways to move through combat.

pages.title: 1 Square
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: 1 Square turns a series of numbered platforms into a jumping puzzle. Landing on a square reduces its number; once it reaches one, another jump removes it. Work out a route that clears every square while keeping you from falling or being caught by the liquid. Clearing the board opens the next challenge.

pages.title: City Blocks
pages.creator: DevDude
pages.description: Build a city within a limited grid in City Blocks. Place new buildings and use its match-three mechanic to upgrade them, making room for the settlement to grow. The challenge is to fit each arrival into your plans and develop the largest city you can before all available space is used.

pages.title: Bubble Fight IO
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Bubble Fight IO turns bubble shooting into a contest between opponents. Players alternate shots at a shared cluster in the middle of the arena. Knocking down more bubbles increases the damage dealt to your rival. Hold to aim, then release the shot, and work toward reducing the opponent’s health to zero.

pages.title: Winter Memory
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Winter Memory briefly reveals a collection of pictures before turning them face down. Remember where each one sits, then uncover matching pairs to remove them. The layouts grow as you progress: the opening level has two pairs, while the tenth contains twenty. Each larger board gives you more positions to keep track of.

pages.title: Squid Sniper Game
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Watch the contestants and identify forbidden movement in Squid Sniper Game. Aim your sniper rifle at players who move during the red-light, green-light challenge. Correct targets add points, while shooting someone who should be left alone reduces your score. Accurate identification matters as much as landing the shot.

pages.title: Horse Derby Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Horse Derby Racing offers races for one player or two, with horses becoming faster after each event. Alternate the left and right arrow keys, or A and D, to make your horse run. The competition travels across seven continents and even reaches Mars, where unicorns provide the fastest opposition. Win every race to claim the championship.

pages.title: Rolling Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Keep your ball ahead of pursuing monsters in Rolling Halloween. Steer past monstrous trees and gravestones while gathering magic skulls, which can upgrade power-ups and unlock additional Halloween balls. Shields, magnets and magical wings appear along the route to help your run continue. The goal is to cover as much distance as possible.

pages.title: Soccer Caps League
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Soccer Caps League brings international soccer to a tabletop-style pitch. Choose a national team and use its cap-shaped players to put the ball into the opposition’s goal. Select a player and drag to set the shot’s direction and strength, then compete for the tournament’s championship cup.

pages.title: Canoe Sprint
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Canoe Sprint puts you in control of a racing canoe. Hold and drag to guide the boat, collecting additional team members along the way. Each person you pick up helps increase the canoe’s speed, linking your progress in the race to the size of your crew.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 640 seconds
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 640 seconds presents a three-dimensional arrangement of symbol tiles to match in pairs. Rotate the structure to look at it from another angle and search for the next pair. You start with 640 seconds, and matches build your score, with bonuses for making matches quickly or repeatedly matching the same symbol.

pages.title: Emoji Puzzle!
pages.creator: Fun Velikan
pages.description: Emoji Puzzle! asks you to work out what connects the pictures in separate columns. Match related symbols by tapping the two elements or dragging a line between them. Each puzzle depends on recognizing an association rather than finding identical images. Connect every element correctly to complete the level.

pages.title: Wild Animals Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Wild Animals Coloring provides eight animal pictures and a palette of twenty-three colors. Choose a drawing and apply your colors, working quickly to improve the score awarded at the end. Once the picture is finished, you can save the colored image.

pages.title: Duck Challenge
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Duck Challenge recreates a fairground shooting gallery with moving duck targets. Follow a target with your sight and click to fire as it travels across the range. Successful hits award points, making the task a matter of tracking the ducks and placing each shot accurately.

pages.title: Pet Wash
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Pet Wash is an animal-care game about cleaning pets after their outdoor adventures. Give the messy animals beauty treatments and help them look tidy again, using mouse clicks or taps to interact.

pages.title: Escape Out
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Escape Out asks you to dig a route to freedom for yourself and your companions. Use your finger to carve a way through the ground, keeping the escape path clear of traps and other obstacles so the group can get out.

pages.title: Warzone Sniper
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Warzone Sniper puts you behind a modern sniper rifle on a large city map. Find and shoot the enemy forces to finish each mission. Left-click to fire, right-click to zoom in on targets, and use P to open the pause menu.

pages.title: Bus Parking Adventure 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Bus Parking Adventure 2020 combines bus driving and parking on mountain routes. Transport tourists to their destination along roads surrounded by mountains and rocks, keeping your passengers safe as you steer through the hilly terrain. Move the bus with WASD or the arrow keys and use Space to brake.

pages.title: Popcorn Box
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Popcorn Box challenges you to fill a container with popcorn while keeping every piece inside. Hold to produce popcorn and watch how much the bucket can take. Avoid spilling it over the sides as you work toward a better rating.

pages.title: ATV Rush
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: ATV Rush sends you along an obstacle-filled route on an ATV, collecting coins as you go. The vehicle gradually accelerates, leaving less time to react to hazards ahead. You have three lives to work with, so avoid obstacles while gathering coins and trying to push your score higher. Use the arrow keys or tap the screen to drive.

pages.title: Castle Slot 2020
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Castle Slot 2020 is a slot machine simulation played with in-game credits. Set the number of active lines and the bet for each line, then spin the reels to look for paying symbol combinations. The spin cost comes from your credit balance, while successful combinations add winnings. A paytable and an automatic spin option are also available.

pages.title: Fruit Hunting
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Fruit Hunting tests your reactions by asking you to catch fruit as it falls. Successful catches earn points, and later levels demand quicker responses. Use the left mouse button to play.

pages.title: Arbor Day Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Arbor Day Differences asks you to compare two Arbor Day pictures and mark everything that differs before time runs out. Finding the changes more quickly gives you a higher score. If a detail is difficult to locate, use the Hint button to help continue the search.

pages.title: Color Rush
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Color Rush sends a glowing ball through colorful tubes. Use the mouse to steer left or right and hit sections that match the ball's color to pass through them. Empty gaps are safe to use, but crossing them breaks your combo and costs bonus points.

pages.title: Memory Scary Game
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Memory Scary Game is a card-matching puzzle in which you uncover two pictures per turn. Remember what each card shows and where it lies, then reveal two identical pictures together. A successful pair disappears from the field and earns points, gradually reducing the number of cards left to match.

pages.title: Flap Bee
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flap Bee has you guide a bee forward through a course of vines. Click the mouse or tap the screen to control its flapping flight and keep it clear of the obstacles.

pages.title: Stickman Ultimate Street Fighter 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Ultimate Street Fighter 3D lets you choose a stickman and fight groups of opponents with attack combinations and a variety of weapons. Work through the battles against different enemy types, using combos to bring them down. Completing the 100-level campaign unlocks an endless mode, and the game includes more than 20 weapons to use during the fights.

pages.title: Crazy Dog Racing Fever
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Crazy Dog Racing Fever puts a racing dog on the track with the aim of winning the championship. Use the Up arrow or W key to increase your dog's speed and compete for the finish.

pages.title: Girl Soldiers Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Girl Soldiers Puzzle is a jigsaw game with six pictures of anime girl soldiers. Choose a picture, then assemble it using 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Monster Truck City Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Monster Truck City Parking puts large trucks through a series of parking challenges. Steer toward the parking spaces and line up your vehicle, with different monster trucks and upgrades available. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, Space for the handbrake, and C to change the camera while positioning the truck.

pages.title: Extreme Bike Rider
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Extreme Bike Rider sends you across platform courses on a motorcycle. Use WASD to control the bike and make your way to the finish. The game includes a score system and a selection of levels, with checkpoints placed along the courses.

pages.title: Xtreme Spike Jumping Square
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Xtreme Spike Jumping Square challenges you to guide a square through narrow passages lined with spikes. Jump, fly, and flip through the obstacles while avoiding their sharp edges. Use the mouse to control the action.

pages.title: Bug Buddies Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Bug Buddies Match 3 is a matching puzzle with colorful bug tiles. Arrange matching colors in groups of at least three to score points. Keep an eye on the gauge on the left: if it drops too far, the game ends.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Astronaut
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Adam and Eve: Astronaut asks you to help Adam leave in a spaceship. Click or tap objects in the scenes to interact with them as you work toward his departure.

pages.title: Head Sports Basketball
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Head Sports Basketball is a simplified basketball contest in which you try to outscore an opponent. Pick a character and adjust its appearance before setting up the match. You can change the court, weather, computer difficulty, and match length. During play, use the arrow keys to move and jump, and press Z to strike the ball.

pages.title: Hyper Sliding Puzzle Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Sliding Puzzle Party asks you to rebuild a picture by moving its square tiles. One space is empty, and neighboring tiles can slide into that gap. Choose an image and a 3-by-3, 4-by-4, or 5-by-5 grid, then work the shuffled pieces back into their correct positions to restore the picture.

pages.title: Tuk Tuk Rush
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Tuk Tuk Rush has you drive a tuk-tuk to pick up passengers and take them to their assigned destinations. Complete these transport tasks across a series of levels. Use WASD to move, press C to switch the camera, and Escape to pause as you travel between pickups and drop-offs.

pages.title: Fun Birds Hidden Stars
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fun Birds Hidden Stars is a timed search for stars concealed in bird pictures. Find ten stars in each scene and work through six levels. Click or tap a star when you spot it, but search carefully: repeated incorrect selections remove an extra five seconds from the clock. Find every star before the remaining time runs out.

pages.title: City Bus Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: City Bus Simulator gives you a bus to drive through a series of levels across two environments. Different bus skins let you change its appearance. Use WASD to control the vehicle and press C to switch the camera as you drive.

pages.title: Space Prison Escape 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Space Prison Escape 2 follows two heroes captured by aliens on their journey back to Earth. Guide them through a prison on another planet, navigating platforms and avoiding enemies and spike traps. The characters have separate keyboard controls for two players, and movement abilities include double jumping and hanging on walls.

pages.title: Oink Run
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Oink Run is a distance-running game starring a piglet. Collect diamonds to fire at the poisonous mushrooms blocking your path, and keep going as far as you can. Temporary wings let the pig fly, while a parachute helps during airborne sections. Click, tap, or press Space to jump; use Z to shoot and X to open the parachute.

pages.title: BTS Cat Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Cat Coloring lets you choose a cat picture and color it with the available brushes. Use the mouse or tap to work on the image, selecting colors as you build your own version of the drawing.

pages.title: Birds Coloring
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Birds Coloring lets you decorate bird pictures with a palette of colors. Choose an illustration, then use the brush to draw or the paint bucket to fill an area. You can change the brush size and use the eraser to revise your work before moving on to another picture.

pages.title: Big Balls
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Aim and fire colored balls around the enclosed board in Big Balls. Fusing balls makes them grow toward an explosion, and destroyed balls contribute to your score. You have a limited supply of shots, with a counter showing how many remain.

pages.title: Color Blast 3D
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Color Blast 3D is a color-matching obstacle game in which you guide a bouncing ball forward. Tap to make the ball bounce, and time its passage through colored obstacles so the colors match. Some sections ask you to hold the ball still while waiting for the right color, then release it to continue.

pages.title: American Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: American Cars Jigsaw offers 12 car pictures to rebuild from scattered puzzle pieces. Pick a picture and choose a difficulty: easy uses 25 pieces, medium uses 49, and hard uses 100. Move the pieces into place with the mouse or touchscreen until the chosen car image is complete.

pages.title: Airplane Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Airplane Coloring Book gives you airplane illustrations to paint in your own colors. Choose a picture, select a color for the brush, and apply it to the drawing to create your own version of the aircraft.

pages.title: Maze Tower
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Maze Tower sends adventurers through 16 labyrinths to collect precious stones guarded by monsters and traps. Explore alone, cooperate with a second player, or compete against a friend in the two-player racing mode. Double jumps and wall jumps help you negotiate the towers, while punches let you fight along the way. Player one uses WASD to move, F to hit and R to run; player two uses the arrow keys, L and P.

pages.title: Casino Cards Memory
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Casino Cards Memory challenges you to find identical playing cards and match every pair before the timer expires. Keep track of the cards you find so you can locate their partners and complete the board within the available time.

pages.title: Tattoo Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Tattoo Salon puts you in charge of creating tattoos for customers. Choose where the tattoo will go, with locations including the arm, neck, waist and back, then select a design. Work with the tattoo machine and ink colors, and use the decoration choices to finish the artwork. The mouse controls the salon tools and selections.

pages.title: 2048 Dragon Island
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: 2048 Dragon Island turns tile merging into a chain of dragon evolutions. Swipe in any of four directions to move the pieces and combine matching dragons. Begin with eggs and work toward the Master Dragon, earning points as matches succeed. The evolution chain has ten stages.

pages.title: Knight's Diamond
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Knight's Diamond is a dungeon platform adventure in which you must find a diamond and reach the exit door. Break boxes and fight skeletons to collect coins, useful powers and treasure. Coins unlock additional knights, while health, shields and sword powers help with the journey. Later levels add a time limit. Use the arrow keys to move and jump and the space bar to swing your sword, or use the on-screen buttons.

pages.title: WodBlox
pages.creator: Julio Cesar Fuente Saugar
pages.description: WodBlox is a sliding-block puzzle about freeing a green block from a crowded board. Move the wooden blocks that obstruct its route, arranging enough space for the green piece to reach the exit. There are 45 levels with different layouts and difficulties, each asking you to work out which blocks must move first.

pages.title: Princess Makeover Time
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Makeover Time combines makeup choices with a wardrobe makeover. Give the princess a new makeup look first, then choose an outfit to go with it.

pages.title: Cat Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Cat Girl Dress Up lets you assemble a cat-themed outfit from a wardrobe of separate items. Choose tops and bottoms or a dress, then change the hairstyle, shoes and accessories. The wardrobe also includes tails, gloves and headpieces. Use the category buttons to browse items and select the combinations you want to see on the character.

pages.title: Princess Trendy Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Trendy Outfits asks you to create a coordinated look for a princess. Start with her makeup, then move on to choosing clothes for the finished makeover.
